title: Meals You Can't Miss
editorial: Chilean food wasn’t as memorable as the rest of Latin America, but we did relish a rabbit dish (conejo escabeche) at Liguria in Providencia, Santiago.
In Rapa Nui and Patagonia, our advice would be to cook your own meals to the extent possible owing to how prohibitively expensive food is in these remote regions.
The fish at Kanahau in Rapa Nui was well prepared, but fairly expensive (around $25 per person in 2023)!
Restaurante Bahia Mansa is Puerto Natales came recommended by the staff at the Chilean embassy in NYC and their seafood did not disappoint!
Inside Torres del Paine National Park, we ate at our Airbnb for $22 per meal, which also felt unreasonably expensive for what was on offer.
